beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Moses pitched a tent a little way outside the camp and called it the Tent of Meeting. It was the place he went to be with God — set apart, quiet, away from everything else.

timing.text: Moses pitched a tent a little way outside the camp and called it the Tent of Meeting.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Whenever Moses walked out to that tent, something happened that had never happened for anyone.

timing.text: Whenever Moses walked out to that tent, something happened that had never happened for anyone.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: All the people would rise and stand, each at the door of their own tent, and watch him go, and worship — because they knew where he was going, and who was waiting for him there.

timing.text: All the people would rise and stand, each at the door of their own tent, and watch him go, and worship — because they knew where he was going, and who was waiting for him there.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: As Moses reached the tent, a great pillar of cloud would come down and stand at the door — the presence of God himself, come down to meet one man.

timing.text: As Moses reached the tent, a great pillar of cloud would come down and stand at the door — the presence of God himself, come down to meet one man.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend.

timing.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Not a master barking at a servant. Not a king across a vast throne room — easy, honest, close. God wanted Moses. Not just his obedience. His friendship.

beats.speaker: god
beats.text: My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.

timing.text: My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Not send someone ahead. Not watch from somewhere far off. Go with you.

timing.text: Not send someone ahead.
Not watch from somewhere far off.
Go with you.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And that friendship made Moses bold. He asked for the one thing no one had ever dared to ask.

timing.text: And that friendship made Moses bold.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.

timing.text: I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.

beats.speaker: god
beats.text: I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee.

timing.text: I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Show me your glory, Moses asked. And God answered — I will make all my goodness pass in front of you. Not his power. Not his greatness. His goodness. Of everything he could have shown a friend, that is what he chose.

timing.text: Show me your glory, Moses asked.

beats.speaker: god
beats.text: Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.

timing.text: Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That was not a refusal. It was care — the way you would not hand a child something far too heavy to hold.

timing.text: That was not a refusal.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So God did the gentlest thing. He tucked Moses into a cleft in the rock, and covered him with his own hand, and let all his goodness pass by — near enough to feel, too much to look on. He protected his friend even from the weight of his own glory.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And when Moses came back down, his face was shining. He did not even know it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That is what happens to someone who spends time close to God — you start, quietly, to glow with a little of him. It began with a friendship, at a tent, outside the camp.

card.text: God spoke with a man as with a friend, and hid him in a rock to keep him safe from too much glory. He still wants to be known like that — not feared from far off, but known up close. Would you let him be that kind of friend to you?
